title: Ralph Tracer Bullet

overview.description: A Ralph-loop based project to be used with the Ralph-TUI terminal user interface.
overview.purpose: This project won't produce anything real, but will be used as a tracer bullet to ensure that Ralph-TUI and its dependencies are working well.

goals: Validate Ralph-TUI core loop functionality with local task trackers (prd.json, beads)
future_scope: GitHub Issues integration for reading tasks/PRDs
open_questions: What specific features should this tracer bullet project test?
What dependencies need to be validated?
